How to explore

  • ZoomScroll to zoom in and out. Keep zooming out past Neptune for the stars, the Milky Way and the whole universe.Pinch to zoom in and out. Keep zooming out past Neptune for the stars, the Milky Way and the whole universe.
  • Look aroundDrag to turn the view.Drag to turn the view.
  • ExploreClick anything for its story. Double-click to fly there.Tap anything for its story, with a button to fly there.
  • JumpThe Scale list jumps between levels; HOME flies you back to Earth.
  • Time▶ sets the planets moving. Tap the date to visit any day from 1800 to 2050, or an eclipse.
  • Stand on EarthSee the sky puts you on the ground under that moment's sky.
  • PictureThe camera saves a clean shot of the view, without the menus or names.
  • ListenThe ♪ plays or pauses the soundtrack.
